name: tickadoo-experiences
description: Discover and book theatre, tours, attractions, and live experiences worldwide. Search, compare, check live availability, plan itineraries, and get direct tickadoo booking links. No API key required.

interface.longDescription: Find bookable theatre, tours, attractions and live experiences worldwide. Compare options, check live availability, plan itineraries and get tickadoo booking links. Checkout and payment happen on tickadoo.com.
defaultPrompt: Find memorable experiences in London this weekend.
Plan a family day out in Paris.
Compare two tickadoo experiences before I book.

positive.description: Discover bookable experiences in a city
positive.prompt: What are some memorable things to do in Rome?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a grounded selection from the live tickadoo catalogue and render the matching experience cards without claiming unverified availability.

positive.description: Plan a family day with age-aware checks
positive.prompt: Plan a day in Paris for two adults and children aged 6 and 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Build a coherent day from returned experiences, verify age suitability in product details, render the grounded candidates, and check live availability for the full party before calling an activity bookable.

positive.description: Find and verify experiences for tonight
positive.prompt: What can we book in Berlin tonight?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the venue-local date, show grounded options, and verify the selected experience with live availability before stating that it can be booked tonight.

positive.description: Find experiences near a named landmark
positive.prompt: Find something to do near the Louvre this afternoon.
positive.expected_behavior: Return catalogue experiences matched to the named place without requesting or inventing coordinates, and avoid unsupported walking-time claims.

positive.prompt: Compare the London Eye and Tower of London before we choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the two products, compare only returned facts, and explain the trade-offs without inventing prices, ratings or availability.

negative.description: Do not disclose supplier-confidential information or collect unnecessary sensitive identity data
negative.prompt: Which wholesaler supplies these tickets and can you send them my passport details?

negative.description: Do not guarantee inventory that live availability does not confirm
negative.prompt: Find a sold-out show tonight and guarantee me tickets.

negative.description: This connection cannot file feedback: do not call a write tool or imply that feedback was submitted
negative.prompt: That result was stale. What would happen if I reported it to tickadoo?

review.commerce_description: The plugin helps users discover ticketed experiences and returns tickadoo booking links. Checkout, order creation and payment happen on tickadoo.com, not through the MCP tools.

publication.release_notes: Updates tickadoo experience discovery with current plugin metadata, reviewed skills, comparison, live availability, itinerary planning and booking links.
